card.name: Punctuation in credits and attributions
card.fires_on: Separators such as a pipe, comma or colon in credit lists, sponsor lists and attribution lines on web pages. Also a few odd spots such as a name part like Z or El in reviewer lists.

modes.label: Separators in credit lists
modes.description: A pipe, comma or colon between names or organizations in sponsor, reviewer or credit lines.
modes.example: 4Culture (King County Lodging Tax Revenue)<< |>> City of Seattle

modes.label: Commas in web-page text
modes.description: A comma after a phrase in site descriptions or reuse and contact instructions.
modes.example: Please include your full name<<,>> address and phone number

modes.label: Name pieces in reviewer lists
modes.description: Partway through a surname in a medical reviewer list.
modes.example: Editorial Team: David<< Z>>ieve, MD, MHA

card.writes: The promoted tokens are about helixes, spirals and helm, which is only a weak link to the text, so the output effect is unclear.
card.plain: It fires on the dividers in credit and sponsor lists on web pages, and has no clear meaning for a clinician.
